title.description: The main window title for the SecPanel application.

ssh_executable.description: The path or command name of the SSH client to use.

scp_executable.description: The path or command name of the SCP client to use.

default_port.description: The default port number for SSH connections.

use_agent.description: Whether to enable the ssh-agent for managing keys.

key_directory.description: The default directory where SSH keys are stored.

default_user.description: The default username to use for connections if not specified per profile.

theme.description: The theme name for the Tcl/Tk GUI appearance.

profiles.description: A list of connection profiles to manage in SecPanel.

profiles.items.description: A flat map of fields for a single connection profile.

profiles.items.name.description: Display name for the connection profile.

profiles.items.host.description: Hostname or IP address of the remote server.

profiles.items.port.description: Port number for the SSH connection. Defaults to default_port if not set.

profiles.items.user.description: Username for this specific profile. Defaults to default_user if not set.

profiles.items.auth.description: Authentication method: password, key, or agent.

profiles.items.key_file.description: Path to the private key file for key-based authentication.
